architectural_seams: standards / control crosswalk and component identity
global_invariants: external allow cannot widen a stricter Agent Memory/PAMA result
decision evidence is distinct from enforcement and execution evidence

trace, scanner, benchmark, or evaluation output is evidence rather than truth or authority
historical approval evidence is distinct from one-time approval, reusable grant, and autonomy policy
peer-specific vocabulary stays in adapters unless repeated evidence proves a missing general primitive
